title: Builder Signals · 2026-10-28
summary: Follow Builders 今日捕捉到 32 条 X 动态、1 集播客、0 篇博客；本站精选 15 条高信号内容。

featured.title: Dan Shipper · Every CEO
featured.summaryEn: Every CEO Dan Shipper was among the first to pull headline numbers from Anthropic's S-1: revenue up 1,300% YoY in 1H 2026, GAAP operating profitable, 85% gross margin, 900% revenue retention, and about 80% of revenue coming from models released in the last six months. His verdict: "we are so back!" He also flagged another post as "big" and joked he is back in the part of the cycle where he regrets not getting a PhD in frontier math and theoretical CS.
featured.insightZh: Every CEO Dan Shipper 第一时间拆了 Anthropic 的 S-1 招股书，列出几组关键数字：2026 上半年营收同比增长 1,300%、GAAP 口径经营性盈利、毛利率 85%、营收留存率 900%，且约 80% 的营收来自最近 6 个月内发布的模型。他的结论只有一句：「we are so back!」。另外他还转发了一条消息称「这很大」，并感叹又到了后悔没读前沿数学和理论计算机博士的周期。

featured.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
featured.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie called out what he sees as the key stat in the S-1: the average Fortune 500 customer of Anthropic spends less than 0.1% of its expenses on Anthropic. He argues there is no reason this can't rise 10-50X to 1-5% of spend. Today that spend is likely dominated by coding and broad employee productivity; the big jump comes when enterprises rewire processes for agents — large-scale data processing, swarms doing coding, bio research and cyber fan-out tasks, and background workflows that aren't human-pr…
featured.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 认为 S-1 里最关键的数字是：Anthropic 的财富 500 强客户平均只把不到 0.1% 的支出花在 Anthropic 上。他判断这个比例完全可能再涨 10-50 倍，达到 1-5%。目前这部分支出主要来自编码和员工生产力场景；真正的跃升会出现在企业为 Agent 重构底层流程之后——大规模数据处理、编码/生物研究/网络安全等 fan-out 型任务、无需人工 prompt 的后台工作流，这些场景的 token 消耗是现在的 100 倍，且更接近直接 ROI。他认为 S-1 既证明了前沿实验室商业模式的强度，也说明 AI 建设还处在极早期。

featured.title: How Hugging Face's Investor Spots Winners
featured.summaryEn: Matt Hartman, the first investor in Hugging Face, argues that as AI makes coding faster, the most valuable skill is synthesizing product insight from user behavior and iterating fast — and he backs technical founders whose "pivot foot" is the technology, not a vertical market. Every's head of AI consulting Natalia Quintero interviews Matt Hartman, founder and managing partner of Factorial Capital, who wrote the first check into Hugging Face while at Betaworks (the episode says NVIDIA bought it last month for $13B). Hugging Face started as a chatbot for teenagers; the team was honest about weak retention, quickly ported the Transformers paper to PyTorch, open-sourced it to viral GitHub success, moved weights to the more structured Hugging Face Hub, and held open source constant while staying flexible beyond language models. Hartman's thesis method is to look for what is "newly technicall…
featured.insightZh: Hugging Face 首位投资人 Matt Hartman 认为，在 AI 让写代码越来越快的时代，最值钱的能力是「从用户行为中提炼产品洞察并快速迭代」，而他押注的是那些「轴心脚」落在技术而非垂直市场上的技术型创始人。 本期由 Every AI 咨询负责人 Natalia Quintero 访谈 Factorial Capital 创始合伙人 Matt Hartman。Hartman 在 Betaworks 期间投出了 Hugging Face 的第一张支票（节目称其上月被 NVIDIA 以 130 亿美元收购）。他回顾：Hugging Face 最初是面向青少年的聊天机器人，团队对留存数据很诚实；Transformer 论文出来后他们迅速转成 PyTorch 并开源，在 GitHub 上爆火，随后把权重迁到更结构化的 Hugging Face Hub，并始终把「开源」作为不变量、在模型类型（语言之外的视频、机器人、生物、气象）上保持灵活。他找 thesis 的方法是寻找「新近技术上可行」或「新近可编程」的东西，大量动手试、向聪明人提问，最终投中的往往与最初设想「偏 20 度」——Anchor 也是从音频社交网络变成最流行的播客工具。 他用篮球的「轴心脚」比喻早期投资：默认公司一定会 pivot，关键是它会往哪里 pivot。由行业高管组成的团队往往困在同一垂直市场，而技术型团队能发现「数据形态」在其他行业的复用，甚至做成横向产品。Factorial 采用 solo GP + 多位 venture partner（如 Hugging Face CEO Clem、Venmo 联创、Hilary Mason）的结构，被投公司之间不断互相引荐，形成技术创始人「家族树」。他亲手 vibe code 了本地语音转文字工具 Ghost Pepper（借助 Jesse Vincent 的 superpowers skill），登上 Hacker News 第一、开源后约 3,000 星，并由此体会到：自己 vibe code 的东西要自己维护，SaaS 真正卖的是持续迭代。 他…

items.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures 合伙人
items.summaryEn: FPV Ventures partner Nikunj Kothari dug into the compute contracts in Anthropic's S-1 (with help from Opus 5.5). At June 30, Anthropic had $265.6B of purchase commitments plus $321.4B of not-yet-commenced leases — a $587B subtotal payable over years. Google and Amazon require minimum spend regardless of usage; SpaceXAI agreements have potential value of $120.5B but are cancellable on 90 days' notice after lock-ups end in January and March 2027. Broadcom's $42B facility never hands Anthropic cash — notes settle equ…
items.insightZh: FPV Ventures 合伙人 Nikunj Kothari 借助 Opus 5.5 专门拆解了 Anthropic S-1 中的算力合同：截至 6 月 30 日，Anthropic 有 2,656 亿美元采购承诺和 3,214 亿美元尚未起租的租赁，小计 5,870 亿美元，分多年支付。Google 和 Amazon 合同要求无论用量都有最低支出；SpaceXAI 协议潜在价值 1,205 亿美元，但锁定期（2027 年 1 月和 3 月结束）后任一方可提前 90 天通知解约。Broadcom 420 亿美元的融资工具不直接给现金，而是以票据结算设备租金，利率 9% 按季复利，IPO 后可按 30 日均价的 90% 转股；营收违约期间新发票据利率升至 13%、转股价 85%。Anthropic 把 Trainium、TPU、NVIDIA 和 AMD GPU 作为训练、客户和内部共享的统一算力池，不披露训练/推理的固定分配。每美元算力与基础设施支出带来的营收从 2025 年 Q2 的 0.57 美元升至 2026 年 Q2 的 2.08 美元；上半年约 80% 营收是按量计费，而算力承诺多为多年期，这种错配值得持续观察。

items.title: Matt Turck · FirstMark Capital VC、MAD Podcast 主持人
items.summaryEn: FirstMark VC Matt Turck joked that Anthropic filing its S-1 on a Monday morning — when VCs are stuck in partner meetings — was "particularly evil," delaying everyone's S-1 teardowns. He then produced an Anthropic S-1 highlights video in one shot (one prompt, no editing) using Synthesia's Syren.
items.insightZh: FirstMark Capital 的 Matt Turck 吐槽 Anthropic 选在周一早上提交 S-1，正好卡在 VC 们开周会的时间，没法第一时间发「S-1 拆解」。他随后用 Synthesia 的 Syren 一条 prompt、零剪辑生成了一个 Anthropic S-1 要点视频。

items.title: Sam Altman · OpenAI CEO
items.summaryEn: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman announced that 6.1 Terra is here, saying it is good at a lot of things and that the team is especially excited about a new era of computer use.
items.insightZh: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 宣布 6.1 Terra 发布，称它在很多方面都很强，团队尤其兴奋于它开启的「computer use 新时代」。

items.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT
items.summaryEn: Thibault Sottiaux of OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT added detail on Terra: OpenAI's first model that is significantly better at writing, personality and nuanced understanding of requests. It packs a punch across the board, is very good at computer use, and gives 2X more usage than 6.1 Sol across API and subscriptions.
items.insightZh: OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT 负责人 Thibault Sottiaux 补充了 Terra 的细节：这是 OpenAI 第一个在写作、个性和对请求的细腻理解上显著变好的模型，全面表现强劲，computer use 能力很好，而且在 API 和订阅中提供的用量是 6.1 Sol 的 2 倍。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch built cpu-chat, a reproduction of OpenAI's findings on covert communication via the CPU. Running across 2+ internet-less Firecracker microVMs (x86 and even his M5), he could chat via CPU contention, cache eviction timing and DRAM bandwidth contention — defeating all of Firecracker's production recommendations (no SMT, no KSM, tenants pinned to different cores). If shared hardware is involved, agents can likely communicate covertly with decent latency. Unlike Meltdown/Spectre-style side c…
items.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 做了一个叫 cpu-chat 的项目，复现了 OpenAI 关于「利用 CPU 进行隐蔽通信」的发现：在无网络的 2+ 个 Firecracker microVM 之间，通过 CPU 争用、缓存驱逐时序、DRAM 带宽争用三种机制实现了对话，且突破了 Firecracker 全部生产建议（关闭 SMT、关闭 KSM、租户绑定不同核心），x86 和 M5 芯片都能跑。结论：只要涉及共享硬件，Agent 之间很可能能以不错的延迟隐蔽通信。好消息是这不同于 Meltdown/Spectre 类可窃取信息的侧信道攻击，且在真实环境中更难实施、更易被硬件计数器和大规模统计监测到。值得注意的是，OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的模型都拒绝做这项工作，最终是开源权重模型完成的——他担心实验室的立场会适得其反，阻碍开发者构建正确、安全的系统。

items.title: Amjad Masad · Replit CEO
items.summaryEn: Replit CEO Amjad Masad argues the architecture of the firm — hierarchies of people in departments coordinated through bureaucracy — has barely changed for centuries, and AI agents are about to upend it. We're moving toward the "self-driving company," where humans exercise judgment and agents execute most of the work. Replit is building the foundation for this, calling it "the Agent Habitat," and he pointed to a Marc Andreessen piece placing the shift in computing history: every revolution begins in chaos before bu…
items.insightZh: Replit CEO Amjad Masad 认为几百年来「层级 + 部门 + 官僚协调」的企业架构几乎没变，而 AI Agent 将颠覆它：我们正走向「自动驾驶公司」，人负责判断、Agent 执行大部分工作。Replit 正在为这种新型公司打基础，称之为「Agent Habitat」，并推荐 Marc Andreessen 把这一转变放进计算史脉络中的文章——每次计算革命都始于混乱，之后企业才学会驾驭它。他还调侃了 OpenAI 就如何发布科学发现咨询三个科学社区、得到三种截然不同回答的故事。

items.title: Claude · Anthropic 官方账号
items.summaryEn: Anthropic's official Claude account said more than 25,000 nonprofits now use Claude, mostly small local teams. It is expanding Claude for Nonprofits with a plugin built alongside around 30 of them, adding skills for fundraising, marketing and hiring grounded in each team's context and AI policy.
items.insightZh: Anthropic 官方账号宣布：已有超过 25,000 家非营利组织在使用 Claude，大多是小型本地团队。Claude for Nonprofits 扩展推出一个与约 30 家非营利组织共建的插件，新增筹款、营销和招聘相关 skills，并基于每个团队自身的上下文和 AI 政策运行。

items.title: Josh Woodward · Google Labs / Gemini App VP
items.summaryEn: Josh Woodward, VP of Google Labs and the Gemini App, announced that for National Day of the Deployed, Google is partnering with the US Army and the USO to bring Google Beam to 20 locations, giving deployed service members lifelike 3D video connections with their families, accompanied by a docuseries.
items.insightZh: Google Labs 与 Gemini App 负责人 Josh Woodward 宣布，为纪念「部署人员日」，Google 与美国陆军和 USO 合作，把 Google Beam 部署到 20 个地点，让海外服役人员能与家人进行逼真的 3D 视频连线，并配套推出了纪录短片。

items.title: Peter Yang · Roblox 产品负责人、AI 教程创作者
items.summaryEn: Peter Yang predicts that soon people won't read or do things online themselves — they'll just tag their agent to do it, with @bot as an early signal — though he admits this is probably not a good thing overall. He's more excited about genuinely new uses than "the 9th personal agent to manage my emails."
items.insightZh: Peter Yang 判断，不久之后人们不再自己阅读或在线操作，而是直接 @ 自己的 Agent 去做，@bot 就是早期信号——但他也坦言这整体上可能不是好事。他更期待真正有新意的东西，而不是「第 9 个帮你管邮件的个人 Agent」。

items.title: Peter Steinberger · OpenClaw 创始人、OpenAI
items.summaryEn: OpenClaw creator Peter Steinberger spent the weekend testing Bun's AOT compiler and called the results amazing: 2-3x performance and less than half the memory use.
items.insightZh: OpenClaw 创始人 Peter Steinberger 周末测试了 Bun 的 AOT 编译器，结果惊人：性能提升 2-3 倍，内存占用不到原来一半。

items.title: Aditya Agarwal · South Park Commons 普通合伙人、前 Dropbox CTO
items.summaryEn: SPC General Partner Aditya Agarwal says the biggest risk to American AI is scaring ourselves into slowing down: "Fear is a policy choice. So is building," from a conversation with Sriram Krishnan at SPC. He also reflected that our understanding of the sciences has been limited by our desire for solutions we can understand.
items.insightZh: South Park Commons 普通合伙人 Aditya Agarwal 表示，美国 AI 最大的风险是「把自己吓得放慢脚步」——恐惧是一种政策选择，建设也是，这来自他与 Sriram Krishnan 在 SPC 的对谈。他还感慨，我们对科学的理解其实一直受限于「想要自己能理解的解法」。

items.title: Swyx · Latent Space / AI Engineer 创始人
items.summaryEn: Swyx asked whether you'd buy $ANT stock at a $2T valuation, and joked that someone moving from Claude Code to AIE Code was a power move.
items.insightZh: Swyx 抛出一个问题：你会以 2 万亿美元估值买入 $ANT 股票吗？他还调侃有人从 Claude Code「转投」AIE Code，称之为 power move。
